name: 69 Poses
source:
He's irresistible. Those who haven't met him, simply haven't experienced love in the right way, What harm can only five minutes in his arms cause? Give in to an incredible love experience and try out all the poses!

[From in-app]
translation:
他是不可抗拒的。没有见过他的人，根本就没有正确地经历过爱情，在他怀里仅仅五分钟能带来什么伤害？体验令人难以置信的爱情体验并尝试所有姿势！

[来自应用程序内]
